note: The numbers the performance model is built on. The rule PLAN-04 states is the one that matters here: 未知不是 0. A parameter nobody has measured is recorded as null with a `source` of `unmeasured`, and the model refuses to run rather than treating it as free. A zero written where a measurement belongs is a cost model that predicts a machine with no cost.

banks.note: R3-03 delivers a banked synchronous VRF; today's rtl/core/tnca_vector_rf.v is a behavioural array with asynchronous reads and no banking, so there is no bank count to record.

read_ports.note: the behavioural model answers every read in the same cycle; the number of physical ports that would support that is exactly what R3-03 has to decide.

write_ports.note: two write ports exist today: the vector writeback and the transfer engine's.

read_latency_cycles.note: asynchronous read. This is the thing R3-03 changes, and it is recorded as 0 because it IS 0 today, not because it is unknown.

command_latency_cycles.note: tools/r1/regression.py REG-10 measures it from a +donetrace run on tb_core: the matrix command completes 224 cycles after issue for a K16 f16 fragment. That measurement is what the collision experiment solves against.
same +donetrace run: an 8-register window transfer completes about 72 cycles after issue.

units_per_cycle.note: one 8-byte unit per cycle, one memory request each.

ooo.note: the jitter is what makes the reorder path reachable at all; before R1-08 the latency was fixed and nothing ever returned out of order.

lsu_outstanding.note: the beat table's size is a parameter; the number that matters for the model is how many are outstanding in practice, which R3-06's counters will report.

completion_ports.note: matrix done, matrix source-free, transfer done -- summed rather than muxed, so two completions in one cycle are both counted. REG-10 exercises it.

simulation_rate.note: Not a hardware property. How fast THIS host simulates, measured by tools/r3/scout.py, and the number R3's execution budget is derived from. It is not a clock frequency and no report may present it as one.
